h1: Custom 150 to 200 Page Badge ID Holders
metaTitle: Custom 150-200 Page Badge ID Holders | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom 150 to 200 page badge ID holders in bulk. Ideal for large events. Get a quote today at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: For events or facilities requiring frequent badge changes, 150 to 200 page badge ID holders offer the capacity to pre-load multiple credentials without constant restocking. These thick books are ideal for security checkpoints, multi-day conferences, or visitor logs where you need quick access to hundreds of IDs. Choose from clear vinyl pouches or heavy-duty nylon wallets that accommodate standard 3" x 5" or 4" x 6" inserts, and add your logo via screen printing or full-color imprinting for a professional look.
heroAltText: Custom 150 to 200 page badge ID holders with clear vinyl pouches and full-color logo imprinting
